jordan: Planning a brief maintenance: runtime kernel patch + temporary model pin for EU/APAC. Need short statuspage blurb + customer email.
mei: Clarify: pin to which model variant?
jordan: Pin to redwood-chat-2.3.1-serve for duration. No model weight changes.
hassan: Fallback target redwood-chat-2.2.8-serve. If latency or errors spike, we rollback.
deploy-bot: Job 3061112222 created: canary eu-west-1 5% traffic at 23:40 UTC, rollout eu at 00:00 UTC, apac at 01:00 UTC.
statusbot: Draft statuspage: "Planned maintenance: brief runtime update in EU & APAC. Expect short cache warm-up and possible transient throttling (~10 mins)." Timeline included.
support-ana: I'll draft two email variants: standard + executive. Include opt-out/reschedule link.
mei: Smoke thresholds: if p95 > baseline*1.25 OR error-rate >1% for 3m -> rollback.
hassan: Add step to revoke patched kernel on failing hosts and route traffic to dedicated pools during rollback.
jordan: Internal pin command: `rb pin --model redwood-chat-2.3.1-serve --regions eu*,ap* --window 2026-03-25T23:35Z/2026-03-26T02:00Z`
deploy-bot: Canary passed at 23:46 UTC (p95 +6%, error 0.2%). Starting EU rollout.
statusbot: Reminder: public wording should say "instance cache warm-up" instead of internal terms.
support-ana: Localized emails uploaded to #support-drafts. Pre-notify to VIP customers done.
jordan: Post-maint: gather perf deltas, token-costs, and publish short note. If rollback occurs we'll run a brief postmortem. Closing unless blockers. :thumbsup:
